reasons: Cited text supports the compliant claim: § 8.2 provides successive twelve-month renewal terms with a Customer opt-out on 30 days' written notice plus a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal (with deadline extension if missed), matching the preferred position.
§ 8.3 caps renewal uplifts at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and 3%, with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods — exactly the preferred price cap.
No walk-away triggers: notice window is 30 days (≤ 90) and renewal terms are 12 months, not multi-year; deterministic check confirms value=30.
Consistent with the compliant status, no redline or comment is proposed, which is appropriate here.
